caption: The drawing depicts a single black boot shown in profile, facing to the left. The boot is mid-calf length, with visible creases and folds that suggest it is made from a flexible material, possibly leather. The texture is emphasized with highlights and shadows, mostly in shades of black and dark brown, with some lighter brown and grey areas to indicate wear and shine. The sole and heel are also dark brown, with a wooden appearance on the heel. At the top of the boot, a light brown rectangular tag or piece of fabric sticks out, possibly for pulling the boot on. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or designs. The artist's signature and date are lightly visible below the boot.
title: Man's Boot
